496:t_1:3.en: ～Deep-space $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$　Bridge～

496:t_1:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Captain $$ジンネマン$$. Thank you for guarding the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

496:t_1:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I didn't do much. This ship's stealth systems are almost flawless.」

496:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「Even $$サイデリアル$$ can't do much if we keep changing position.」

496:t_1:7.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「Meanwhile, we gathered forces opposed to $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and supported groups conducting guerrilla operations across the region.」

496:t_1:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「I've put you through a lot too, $$ナナイ$$. And...」

496:t_1:9.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You needn't worry about me, $$シャア$$. As the princess of $$ジオン$$, I am simply doing everything I can.」

496:t_1:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Once we've resupplied here, we intend to keep $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements in check.」

496:t_1:12.en:
$$ナナイ$$
「I understand. Allow me to explain the current situation in space around the $$蒼の地球$$.」

496:t_1:16.en: ～$$ソレスタルビーイング号$$　$$ヴェーダ$$ Core～

496:t_1:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How is it going, $$ティファ$$?」

496:t_1:19.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...It's no use. I can't sense anything from $$ヴェーダ$$...」

496:t_1:20.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I hoped your $$脳量子波$$, which contacted $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$, might be able to...」

496:t_1:22.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You needn't worry about it, $$ティファ$$. Thank you for helping.」

496:t_1:23.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You don't seem too down about it, $$ティエリア$$.」

496:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you okay with that? There's supposed to be information about $$クロノ$$ inside $$ヴェーダ$$, right?」

496:t_1:26.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We cannot do the impossible. Getting impatient won't help.」

496:t_1:27.en:
$$パーラ$$
「This $$クロノ$$ exists in all sorts of worlds and has been manipulating history from the shadows, right?」

496:t_1:28.en:
$$パーラ$$
「I don't get it. What the hell have they been doing all that for?」

496:t_1:29.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If $$ヴェーダ$$ would answer us, we might have learned everything about $$クロノ$$.」

496:t_1:30.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We can find that answer ourselves in the battles ahead.」

496:t_1:31.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're pretty positive about it.」

496:t_1:32.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「My former self would probably not have reacted this way.」

496:t_1:33.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But through our battles in $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and $c, I learned what it means to overcome hardship.」

496:t_1:34.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Maybe $$ヴェーダ$$'s been silent all this time to teach you that.」

496:t_1:35.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「...You mean...this is a trial...?」

496:t_1:36.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(It is not inconceivable, given who $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ was...)

496:t_1:37.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$イオリア$$ pursued the $$イノベイター$$ plan while evading $$クロノ$$'s scrutiny...)

496:t_1:38.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(What $$クロノ$$ calls managing humanity's evolution probably amounts to stopping that evolution...)

496:t_1:40.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'm all right, $$ティファ$$. ...As an $$イノベイド$$ who guides humanity's evolution, I consider fighting $$クロノ$$ my mission.」

496:t_1:41.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I feel the same way.」

496:t_1:43.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ said the power I possess is not humanity's evolved form.」

496:t_1:44.en:
$$ティファ$$
「That is precisely why, if humanity evolves, I want to see it.」

496:t_1:47.en:
$$ティエリア$$
($$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... If $$クロノ$$ stands in the way of humanity's future, which you entrusted to us, I will overcome it.)

496:t_1:48.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(And as an $$イノベイド$$, I will see for myself what lies ahead for $$イノベイター$$s...for the life $$刹那$$ leads.)

496:t_1:53.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$イアン$$, these parts are for the $$ハルート$$, right!?」

496:t_1:54.en:
$$イアン$$
「Yeah, that's right! Leave the $$サバーニャ$$ to $$アストナージ$$. I'm counting on you to handle that one's running gear!」

496:t_1:55.en:
$$リンダ$$
「We assembled the parts developed at our $$木星$$ base here. Now we just need to install them on each machine.」

496:t_1:56.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Yes, I understand! This will power up $$ロックオン$$'s, $$アレルヤ$$'s and $$ティエリア$$'s $$ガンダム$$s!」

496:t_1:57.en:
$$リンダ$$
「We also increased the output of the colony $$ガンダム$$s and the $$トールギスⅢ$$ by replacing their parts with the latest ones.」

496:t_1:58.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$ modified $$ヒイロ$$'s group of $$ガンダム$$s?」

496:t_1:59.en:
$$リンダ$$
「Former $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ engineers were involved in developing those $$ガンダム$$s. That's why some of their standards match ours.」

496:t_1:60.en:
$$リンダ$$
「However, the $$ウイングゼロ$$, the culmination of their technology, had so many unique systems that we couldn't work on it...」

496:t_1:61.en:
$$イアン$$
「We got them suits, too. Fighting in light clothing would be tough in the battles ahead.」

496:t_1:62.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're really pulling out all the stops.」

496:t_1:63.en:
$$イアン$$
「The $$ガンダム$$s aren't the only ones getting upgrades. Commander $$レディ・アン$$ also sent us a $$トランザム$$ activation program for pseudo-$$ＧＮドライヴ$$s.」

496:t_1:64.en:
$$イアン$$
「Once we install it, Major $$グラハム$$'s and Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$'s machines will be able to use $$トランザム$$, too.」

496:t_1:65.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「So the age of $$トランザム$$ has finally come to machines besides $$ガンダム$$s...」

496:t_1:66.en:
$$リンダ$$
「But making those adjustments requires the utmost care.」

496:t_1:67.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You can count on me, $$リンダ$$. As $$イアン$$'s star pupil, I, $$タクヤ・イレイ$$, will show you some flawless work!」

496:t_1:68.en:
$$イアン$$
「You sure know how to talk. The other day, you were calling $$アストナージ$$ your master.」

496:t_1:69.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「To me, every mechanic in $c is my master!」

496:t_1:70.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's amazing, $$タクヤ$$... They already trust you with all the maintenance on a $$ガンダム$$?」

496:t_1:71.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$タクヤ$$ is working hard! $$タクヤ$$ is working hard!」

496:t_1:72.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Given our situation, I have to pull my weight, too.」

496:t_1:73.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「I might even become your $$ユニコーン$$'s dedicated mechanic someday.」

496:t_1:74.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll wait, but I won't get my hopes up.」

496:t_1:75.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Hey, you! You're not taking me seriously!」

496:t_1:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「He might not be joking. $$タクヤ$$'s been studying the $$ユニコーン$$ thoroughly.」

496:t_1:77.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The modification plan he showed me the other day was quite impressive, too.」

496:t_1:78.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You have a modification plan?」

496:t_1:79.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It's still a secret. I'm recalculating the weight balance with $$カミーユ$$'s guidance right now.」

496:t_1:80.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Anyway, give me a hand, $$バナージ$$. The $$ハルート$$'s refit is much bigger than the $$サバーニャ$$'s, so we need more people.」

496:t_1:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll help you with that, $$タクヤ$$.」

496:t_1:83.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You should rest for a while. Look...」

496:t_1:84.en:
$$ミコット$$
「$$バナージ$$... I brought Lady $$ミネバ$$.」

496:t_1:85.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Please stop that, $$ミコット$$. Haven't we become friends through doing the laundry together?」

496:t_1:86.en:
$$ミコット$$
「You're right. By the end, you were more efficient at it than I was.」

496:t_1:87.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I was a member of $c's housekeeping team, too.」
